note: The clerk's past-election-results index lists no city election of any kind in 2010. The packet states that the mayor serves a four-year term. Mayors were elected in 2011, 2015 and 2019-2020, so none fell in 2010.

The August 30, 2011 mayor and council election had six mayoral candidates and no majority winner (Stanton 37.90 percent). The decisive round was the November 8, 2011 runoff between Greg Stanton and Wes Gullett. The runoff is recorded in phoenix_results.json.
The clerk's past-election-results index lists no city election in 2012. The mayor elected in 2011 serves a four-year term, so no mayoral election fell in 2012.

The index lists a March 12, 2013 special election, an August 27, 2013 council election and a November 5, 2013 council runoff. The clerk citywide summary for March 12, 2013 contains no mayoral contest. The other two are described on the index as council-only. No mayoral election occurred in 2013.
The index lists only a November 4, 2014 special election for this year. The clerk citywide summary for that election was opened and contains no mayoral contest. No mayoral election occurred in 2014.

The August 25, 2015 mayor and council election was decided in the first round: Greg Stanton received 65.31 percent. The index lists no mayoral runoff for 2015. Winner and runner-up are in phoenix_results.json.
The index lists only a November 8, 2016 special council election for District 3 in this year. No mayoral election occurred in 2016.
The index lists an August 29, 2017 council election for Districts 2, 4, 6 and 8 and a March 14, 2017 District 3 runoff. Neither includes a mayoral contest. No mayoral election occurred in 2017.

The November 6, 2018 special election for the mayoral vacancy was a first round with four candidates; Kate Gallego received 44.49 percent, short of a majority. The decisive runoff was held March 12, 2019. No decisive mayoral election occurred in 2018, so the year has status no_election (the status earlier_round_only is reserved for a 2026 first round). The 2018 first round is an earlier round of the contest decided on March 12, 2019. That decisive runoff is recorded in 2019 and the first round is not recorded as a separate election. The August 28, 2018 special election citywide summary contains no mayoral contest. Status set to earlier_round_only on review: the November 6, 2018 first round was held but produced no majority; the decisive runoff on March 12, 2019 is recorded under 2019.

The March 12, 2019 special election, listed on the index as the mayoral runoff, decided the vacancy between Kate Gallego and Daniel Valenzuela. It is recorded in phoenix_results.json. The August 27, 2019 special election citywide summary contains no mayoral contest.
The November 3, 2020 mayor and council election was decided in the first round: Kate Gallego received 60.70 percent. Winner and runner-up are in phoenix_results.json.

The index lists only a March 9, 2021 runoff for Districts 3 and 7. The clerk citywide summary was opened and contains no mayoral contest. The mayor elected in 2020 serves a four-year term. No mayoral election occurred in 2021.
The November 8, 2022 election is a council election for Districts 2, 4, 6 and 8. The clerk summary was opened and contains no mayoral contest. No mayoral election occurred in 2022.

The index lists a March 14, 2023 runoff for Districts 6 and 8 and a November 7, 2023 special bond election. The clerk summaries for both were opened and contain no mayoral contest. No mayoral election occurred in 2023.
The November 5, 2024 mayor and council election was decided in the first round: Kate Gallego received 62.04 percent. Winner and runner-up are in phoenix_results.json.
The index lists no election in 2025. The 2026 clerk candidate packet states that the mayor serves a four-year term, so the next mayoral regular election is November 7, 2028.

The clerk page for the November 3, 2026 election lists only council seats for Districts 2, 4, 6 and 8 and propositions. The mayor is not on the ballot. The candidate packet lists the next mayoral election as November 7, 2028.
